stopping_rule: diagnostic forks run to tick 101; live forks to tick 161
eligibility: at the checkpoint: >=1 verified procedure, and remaining ore >= 1.5 x (ore consumed per tick so far) x window
design: Each seed runs one base world (sharing on, bounded search) to the checkpoint. Matched continuations are forked from that committed state. At the boundary the same verified creators retire under the same inventory rule (to settlement storage) and are replaced by the same number of fresh producers. Only the successors' knowledge policy differs. Invention is frozen identically in all diagnostic forks so relearning cannot mask inherited retention. The live continuation (successor researchers, invention open) is a separate experiment.
parity_mask: successor_access, successor capabilities/known/inheritance, succession-package transmissions, lifecycle package/policy
